answer: A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in one breath. The panel reads the timber for a name, the willow for a number, the sparrow for a date, then asks the farm to account for all three at once. I trust a proof kept by other hands, and Glove lacer suede mark buttoned onto the sewing bench is that proof: each suede is a season of logged cuttings plus a signed glove record. Farm 346 masks as a business and the ledger shows a single expense, 31486 POA locked away, and zero revenue. The threshold can wait out the whole epoch; the farm cannot wait at all, and that is the verdict.
